How to Save Bilibili Videos to iPhone & iPad Camera Roll

Updated for iOS 17 & 18 • 4 Min Read

Thanks to modern iOS Safari file handling, downloading videos directly into your Photos app is quick and does not require complex shortcuts or third-party apps.

Step 1: Copy the Link from the Bilibili App

While watching a video in the official Bilibili iOS app, tap the Share button (arrow icon) on the top-right corner. In the share drawer, tap Copy Link. This will copy a shortlink (such as https://b23.tv/...).

Step 2: Paste into BiliExtract Safari

Open Safari on your iPhone and go to BiliExtract.com. Tap the paste icon inside the search bar. BiliExtract automatically unrolls shortlinks and retrieves the video streams.

Step 3: Download and Move to Camera Roll

  1. Tap the Download MP4 button for your preferred resolution.
  2. Safari will prompt: "Do you want to download [filename]?" Tap Download.
  3. Once downloaded, tap the download icon in Safari's address bar.
  4. Open the video file, tap the iOS Share Sheet (square with arrow), and choose Save Video.

Your Bilibili video is now permanently stored in your iPhone's native Camera Roll!
